answer: Identifiable abort turns a cheating shareholder into evidence: if the joint signature fails, the protocol pinpoints exactly whose share was bad, and the beacon of the mechanism is a public transcript anyone can audit. The ember of the design deters Sybil signers because misbehavior is attributable and punishable, not anonymous. A quorum of honest holders can always complete a signature, while a thread of malicious shares is detected and excluded instead of silently blocking honest users.
